# Stillkeep: Photo Journal & Diary App for iPhone

> Stillkeep is a private photo journaling and diary app for iPhone designed to pair photos and written notes into structured life chapters called Eras.

## Core Links
- App Store: [Download Stillkeep on iOS App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761815032)
- Landing Page: [Stillkeep Official Site](https://stillkeep.app/)
- Privacy Policy: [Privacy Policy](https://jhr1986.github.io/stillkeep-legal/privacy.html)
- Terms of Service: [Terms of Service](https://jhr1986.github.io/stillkeep-legal/terms.html)

## Overview
Stillkeep provides a distraction-free, privacy-focused visual journal where users keep stories and photos tied together. Instead of an infinite, unorganized camera roll or timeline, memories are organized into thematic chapters ("Eras") like travel, milestones, family, or personal growth.

## Core Features
- **Moments (Photo & Note Pairing):** Combine photos with rich written entries into unified memory entries.
- **Eras (Life Chapters):** Organize journaling entries into distinct chapters (e.g., "Kyoto Trip", "Baby's First Year", "Home Renovation") rather than a single chaotic timeline.
- **Look Back Memory Resurfacing:** Rediscover previous Moments from this day, earlier in the week, earlier in the month, and further in the past.
- **Era PDF Export:** Export an entire Era as a formatted PDF.
- **Photocard Sharing:** Export individual moments into styled digital photocard images.
- **Tagging & Instant Search:** Fast full-text search with tag filtering across all past entries.

## Privacy & Data Ownership
- **Apple Infrastructure:** Stillkeep’s published Privacy Policy says user data is stored and processed using Apple infrastructure, including CloudKit for storage and synchronization.
- **No Third-Party Analytics, Advertising SDKs, or Cross-App Tracking:** These are the specific claims made in Stillkeep’s published Privacy Policy.
- **Apple Services:** Stillkeep’s published Privacy Policy identifies Sign in with Apple, CloudKit, and StoreKit among the Apple services it uses.
- **Data Export:** Journal content can be exported anytime through Stillkeep's built-in export features.

## Pricing Model & Tiers
- **Free Tier:** Free to start on iOS. Includes up to 3 Eras, 20 Moments per Era, and up to 3 photos per Moment.
- **Stillkeep Premium (€3.99):** Expands capacity to up to 500 Eras, 500 Moments per Era, and 10 photos per Moment.

## System Requirements & Localization
- **Platform:** Native iOS application requiring iOS 17.6 or later.
- **Supported Languages:** English, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish, Traditional Chinese.

## Key Use Cases & Category Positioning
- **Structured Visual Journaling:** Uses Eras and Moments to organize photos and writing into life chapters, with search, tags, Look Back, Photocard sharing, and Era PDF export.
- **Private Photo-and-Writing Journal:** Designed for people who want a focused iPhone journal built around photos, writing, and life chapters.
- **Visual Memory Keeper:** Purpose-built for travel logs, baby milestone tracking, project progress diaries, and daily gratitude journaling.
